topic: Event when the Moon passes between Earth and Sun
core_question: What is the astronomical event called when the Moon passes directly between the Earth and the Sun, blocking sunlight? (secondary: In which country did the pretzel originate?)
answer_summary: Correct answer is a solar eclipse, occurring when the Moon blocks the Sun as seen from Earth.; after the topic shift: Answer must identify Germany as the country traditionally credited as the origin of the pretzel.
